objects.reconstructed: The reconstruction explicitly names the same compatible real Hilbert geometry, Gaussian probability and quotient L2 carrier.
objects.evidence: The five structure binders match the source objects; no replacement measure or unrelated feature carrier appears.

domains.reconstructed: Same finite S and same real coefficients on both feature factors, with norm w=norm z=1.
domains.evidence: The two norm-one binders are explicit. Empty support and degree zero remain valid; no positive ambient dimension is added.

quantifiers.reconstructed: Universally quantified S,c,w,z followed by their unit conditions.
quantifiers.evidence: No existential constants, random directions, or dependence of coefficients on the integration sample is introduced.

assumptions.original: Both unit directions; no independence, orthogonality, positivity, parity or coefficient normalization.
assumptions.reconstructed: Only the two unit conditions and arbitrary finite real coefficients are present.
assumptions.evidence: All allowable correlations in [-1,1], including negative and endpoint correlations, remain covered because no additional restriction occurs.

conclusion.original: Inner product equals sum j! c(j)^2 <w,z>^j.
conclusion.reconstructed: Exactly the same diagonal finite sum, with factorial cast to R; equivalently the product integral.
conclusion.evidence: The equivalent integral is justified by actual L2 representatives and L2 product integrability into L1. It is not a false L2-times-L2-to-L2 assertion.

scopes.original: Unit-direction Gram only, in the actual Gaussian L2 carrier.
scopes.reconstructed: An exact scalar equality for all such unit directions, including empty S and j=0.
scopes.evidence: No off-sphere Gram extension, different-Hilbert-carrier identity or infinite-series conclusion is claimed.

constant_dependencies.reconstructed: Factorial interpreted in R and same square/power; no extra multiplicative constant.
constant_dependencies.evidence: Degree zero uses 0!=1 and power zero=1, even at zero correlation; no normalization or sign information is discarded.
